tools.name: get_services
tools.description: What Well Prepped Life offers: fresh chef-cooked meal-prep delivery for seniors and disabled adults in the SF Bay Area, pricing, and how to get started. Call this first to answer questions about the service.

tools.name: get_available_slots
tools.description: List open times for the free 15-minute phone consultation. Returns a map of date (YYYY-MM-DD) to UTC ISO start times. Present times to the user in Pacific Time (America/Los_Angeles). Defaults to the next 14 days.

tools.name: book_consultation
tools.description: Book the free 15-minute consultation call at one of the times returned by get_available_slots. Confirm the exact time (in Pacific Time), full name, and email with the user before calling. Fill the optional intake fields from what the user has already shared in conversation — don't interrogate; at mo

tools.name: find_answer
tools.description: Search everything Well Prepped Life publishes — service pages, city pages, guides, and the FAQ set — and get back real URLs plus any matching FAQ answer in our own words. Use this for ANY question get_services does not cover: a medical diet (renal, diabetic, soft food, low sodium), insurance and Med

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "book_consultation" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Book the free 15-minute consultation call at one of the times returned by get_available_slots. Confirm the exact time (in Pacific Time), full name, and email wi…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_answer · Public sink: book_consultation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_answer · Public sink: book_consultation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
